fields.value: Etude report & ops follow-ups from live 5x Colab run

Follow-up operational and report issues observed during `tla_trophies_colab_500k_v2` after PR #146 (`89b394`):

1. **Seated curve breaks on seat-1 opponents during in-progress evals (`src/etude/page.py` `_coverage`, `src/etude/charts.js` `seatedValue`/`gapOf`):**
   - `_coverage` counts `player_checkpoints(match)` for both seats of every match.
   - When `w160l8 u1000 vs u500` or `w64 u1400 vs u700` is in progress (`unplayed > 0`), the *opponent* checkpoints (`w160l8 u500`, `w64 u700`) get `unplayed > 0` in `coverage`.
   - On a seated curve ("Against itself at half its updates"), `charts.js:370/393` sees `c.unplayed > 0` for `u500` and `u700`, plots `○ not yet played` at `u500`/`u700`, and breaks the line between `u400`–`u600` (blue) and `u600`–`u800` (orange) even though `u500`/`u700` are never subjects on that curve.
   - Fix: `_coverage` / `seatedValue` should only mark unplayed gaps for checkpoints that are actually seated as the curve's subject (first seat).

2. **Seated panel subtitle wall of text (`src/etude/page.html` `selName`):**
   - A `head_to_head` curve over 160 seatings (`Colab half-training deal 1 .. 160`) renders all 160 seating names concatenated with ` + ` as a 20-line subtitle above the chart. Summarize/truncate long seating lists (e.g. `Colab half-training deal 1 + ... (160 seatings)`).

3. **Untimed SSH calls block the whole `etude wait` loop (`src/etude/launch/ssh.py`):**
   - `ssh -o BatchMode=yes <host>` has no `ConnectTimeout` or `ServerAliveInterval`/`ServerAliveCountMax`. When the host switches networks or sleeps mid-SSH, the `etude wait --experiment` main loop hangs indefinitely on the SSH child, stopping Colab status polling and failover until the child is killed. Adding `ConnectTimeout` + `ServerAliveInterval`/`ServerAliveCountMax` prevents an unreachable owned machine from wedging the scheduler.

4. **`statsdb._catch_up` memory/time scaling on large 5× eval batches (`src/etude/eval/query.py`):**
   - Ingesting 1,932 newly completed match blocks (7,728 games) sequentially in one DuckDB transaction took ~40 minutes and peaked at ~27 GB RSS. Parallelizing R2 fetches and/or committing periodically per run/chunk avoids the multi-ten-minute single-transaction stall.

5. **`Scheduler.wait()` 1s tick loop CPU spikes & multi-`etude wait` contention (`src/etude/launch/scheduler/loop.py` `wait`):**
   - `Scheduler.wait()` defaults to `every: float = 1.0`, calling `self.tick()` and `self.read(run)` every second across every supply and unsettled session.
   - A single long-running `etude wait --experiment` process used ~5 hours of CPU over 41h wall time (~12% average), and running multiple concurrent `etude wait` processes caused combined spikes of 60–117% CPU on the host due to repeated 1s `tick()` passes and SQLite lock contention.
   - Consider adaptive backoff / longer default poll interval when sessions are steadily running, throttling per-supply observation cadence, and/or avoiding redundant global `tick()` work when another `wait` already holds the supply locks.

6. **Owned-machine `~/.etude/sessions` disk accumulation & wedged `stopping` after bootstrap ENOSPC:**
   - Completed eval sessions on owned machines (`mini-r2`) keep ~4.4 GiB each in `~/.etude/sessions/<id>/attempts/` indefinitely (116 ended sessions filled 78 GiB until `OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device` during bootstrap).
   - Because owned-machine sessions have `startup_deadline=None`, a bootstrap crash before `worker` starts leaves `started_at=None` and `ended_at=None` so even `etude cancel` wedges in `stopping` indefinitely.
   - Clean up or age out `ended` session attempt scratch directories on owned machines, and allow cancelling/failing a session whose bootstrap died before worker startup.
